name: Fire extinguisher + emergency/exit lighting annual inspection route for small Chicago occupancies (first-aid cabinet add-on tested)
summary: OSFM Class A licensed distributor (founder holds Class 1 employee licence via NAFED/ICC exam). Customer unit = small commercial/mixed-use occupancy (~6 extinguishers, ~8 emergency/exit fixtures) on an annual inspection with pull-through (6-year maintenance, hydrotests, replacements, battery/lamp repairs). Revenue is billed at the annual visit; modelled as monthly average ARPC. Technician labour is staff (founder services the first ~350 accounts).
evidence_notes: Illinois public price (Park District of Highland Park, Jul 2025): Fox Valley Fire & Safety $3/extinguisher annual test, 6-yr maintenance $19.75-35.50, hydrotest $30.75-40, 5-lb replacement $85, 10-lb $110; JCI bid $7, $65-110, $70-120, $100, $170 [A, DA-S005]. Volume public prices are a floor.

Small-account price structure: $15-22 per unit plus a $75-125 service-call fee (Tampa operator guide) [D, DA-S007]; Clinton CT public bid $3-4.50/unit with $130/h labour [A, DA-S006]. The Stage C $4.75 anchor is Boone County, MISSOURI (Korsemeyer), not Illinois [A, C1-S001 re-read].
Emergency/exit lighting: annual 90-minute and monthly 30-second tests are code duties [C, DA-S008]; no per-fixture price found (MISSING) - E.

Licensing: Class A distributor $900/3 yrs, Class 1 employee $300/3 yrs, NAFED/ICC exam $320, $1M liability + WC [A, WS05-S001/S002/S025, DA-S003]. Act scheduled to sunset 1 Jan 2028; the 2022 sunset review recommended continuation and P.A. 102-0715 extended it [A, DA-S002, DA-S003].

Market: 184 active distributor licences; 29 issued 2025-26 incl. new Chicago micro-entrants and consolidator re-licensing (Pye-Barker via Phoenix Fire Systems; The Hiller Companies at Reliable Fire Equipment's Alsip address) [A, DA-S004].

Supplier: Brooks Equipment (Elk Grove Village warehouse) sells to fire-equipment distributors; net 30 for approved credit, else COD/card; special orders min $175 [B, DA-S017]. Amerex direct distributorship asks about prior fire-suppression spend and is not guaranteed [B, DA-S018].
Win rates, lead volumes, account mix and pull-through rates are E.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: NAFED/ICC open-book exam [A, WS05-S025]; OSFM distributor + employee licence applications with $1M COI, WC proof, maintenance-equipment access [A, DA-S003]. Processing time MISSING.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Owner-level decision; often triggered by a DOB/fire-inspector citation (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Walk-in conversations with owners/managers of small occupancies; 545 Chicago addresses cited for extinguisher/exit/emergency-light items in 13 months [A, DA-S020] plus ~11,000 food licences [A, C2-S015]. Volume E.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Annual relationship, low switching cost; E.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Operator guide describes ~10-year service relationships [D, DA-S007]; business closures (~10%/13 months for food licences) [A, DA-S001]; base 13.5%/yr E.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Annual base ~$333: 6 ext x $12 + $65 trip + 8 lights x $9 + 6-yr maint (1/6 x 6 x $28) + hydro (1/12 x 6 x $35) + replacements 0.3 x $95 + light batteries/lamps $30 + misc $20. Unit prices bracketed by A public bids [DA-S005] and D small-account guide [DA-S007]; lighting E. Optimistic includes first-aid cabinet add-on on ~20% of accounts (+$10/mo each).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: First-visit corrections: expired/missing units, signage, mounts (DOB cites 'recharge & tag' 300x, 'extinguisher required' 124x in 13 months [A, DA-S020]).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Parts/agent/replacement units ~20-25% of revenue (replacement resale at ~40-50% margin over Brooks cost; inspection is labour-only). Labour in Staff. APi company GM 31.4% includes labour [A, WS05-S019].
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Fuel, tags/labels, card fees, bad debt (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Invoice at visit, net-15/30; small occupancies often pay on site (E).
drivers.inventory_days_cogs__source: Spare 5-lb/10-lb units, agent, valves, batteries on the van (E).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Brooks: net 30 for approved credit, otherwise COD/card [B, DA-S017].
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Active consolidators (Pye-Barker, Hiller, APi) re-licensing acquired Illinois locations 2025-26 [A, DA-S004]; multiples not disclosed (MISSING); 4x assumed.

staff.role: Fire equipment technician (OSFM Class 1 employee licence; incl. van)
staff.notes: Chicago MSA 'installation, maintenance & repair, all other' median $27.36/h [C, DA-S012 proxy] -> ~$4,850 x 1.2 load + van ~$800. ~6-8 small accounts/day => ~1,200-1,500 annual accounts per tech. Employee licence $300 + exam $320. Founder services up to ~600 annual accounts (~2.5 visits/working day) before the first hire; tests: hiring at 350 accounts cuts base yr-5 operating profit to ~$16k (~$5k if a rep is also hired at 500), because ARPC is only ~$28/mo.

staff.role: Office coordinator (scheduling annual due-dates, reports, billing)
Sales rep (commission-heavy), once the route is proven
